name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. Conditionally frees the fast-mode (speed-mode) walk-animation overlay; 'maybe_free' captures the gated free, 'speed_mode_overlay' the resource. Paired with fd2_maybe_load_speed_mode_overlay. No Ghidra address residue.
purpose: Fast-mode battle cleanup: if game-speed (fast) mode is on, free the fast-walk animation overlay that fd2_maybe_load_speed_mode_overlay allocated.
logic_summary: Watcom __CHK(8) stack-probe prologue, then: if (data_fd2_ui_game_speed_flag != 0) free(data_fd2_battle_fast_mode_walk_overlay_ptr). When fast mode is off the overlay pointer was never loaded so nothing is freed. The free+RET tail (entry+0x19 @ 0x1A80A) is a shared epilogue: fd2_play_and_free_status_effect_sfx (@ 0x1D518) tail-JMPs here to reuse the CALL free; ADD ESP,4; RET sequence.
